title: BoardUI: source distribution and requirements
content:
BoardUI distributes editable React component source, rather than a runtime component package. The public starter uses React and React DOM 19.2.4, Tailwind CSS 4, and TypeScript. Individual components record their own npm and BoardUI registry dependencies.

Set up BoardUI theme tokens and global styles before using its components. Follow https://www.boardui.com/installation for current framework, font, dark-mode, and monorepo setup. Component APIs here describe the captured free registry source; the website registry is newer than the public GitHub starter.

The free source uses MIT terms. Pro agent components, charts, and templates require a separate paid license; no Pro source or usage examples are stored in this corpus.
